system.description: Complex and precise manipulations of single objects are now possible, enabling the psychic to operate a machine or fight with melee weapons or firearms using only the mind. CHAPTER FIVE: OCCULT 133 133 A successful activation roll must be made to lift a weapon into the air, after which the weapon remains aloft under the mental control of the psychic for the duration of the power. However, she must make a successful Extrovert+Melee or Shoot roll to swing or fire the weapon at a target (although she does not have to spend more Wyrd).
